📖 How to use

  1. Enter the value of each asset you own.
  2. Enter each liability you owe.
  3. Read your net worth and the full breakdown.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What counts as an asset?

Cash, savings, investments, retirement accounts, home equity (use market value), vehicles and other valuables.

Should I use market value or what I paid?

Current market value — what you could sell it for today. That is what net worth measures.

Can net worth be negative?

Yes, and it is common early in a career (student loans, car loans). The trend over time matters more than one number.
